hypothesis: H-CC1: where high-pass horizontal-gradient maxima of RTP magnetics and isostatic gravity coincide, a discontinuity (fault) is more likely than either gradient alone.
mechanism: Juxtaposition of rock with contrasting susceptibility and density along a discontinuity produces co-located magnetic and gravity gradient maxima; the geometric mean of the two robust z-scores ranks cells.
